mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT recovered 3.7 points over four weeks (-11.1 at t-3w to -7.4 at t-0w), showing that out-of-home trip-making is being progressively restored. Because retail-and-recreation trips draw on the same discretionary trip budget as transit trips, continued transit recovery raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks relative to the last four.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -11.1 at t-3w to -7.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC averaged over the 28 days after 2021-10-15 is not higher than its last 28-day mean of -17.1 while TRANSIT remains on its current recovery path.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM crossed above +20 percent change from baseline in the final week, marking a provisioning surge that pulls household wallet share into essentials. Discretionary retail spend is crowded out by that provisioning, so RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks averages below its last four-week mean of -17.1.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM exceeds +20 percent change from baseline in a weekly mean
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose from 12.9 at t-3w to 22.4 at t-0w
regime_hint: precautionary provisioning regime with GROCERY_PHARM above +20
failure_condition: Weeks in which GROCERY_PHARM exceeds +20 are followed by a higher RETAIL_REC 14-day mean than weeks in which it stays below +15.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES fell 6.8 points in two weeks (-15.1 at t-2w to -21.9 at t-0w) and crossed below -20, the signature of employer or policy-driven return-to-home mandates. Fewer commuters means fewer adjacent retail trips in office districts, so RETAIL_REC moves lower over the next two weeks.

evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell from -15.1 at t-2w to -21.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC 14-day mean after the WORKPLACES crossing is equal to or higher than the 14-day mean before the crossing.

mechanism_narrative: Autumn onset compresses park-based recreation, with PARKS still 22.0 points below baseline, and displaces outdoor leisure into indoor destinations. Indoor commercial venues capture that displaced demand within one week, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next seven days relative to the last seven.

regime_hint: autumn seasonal transition with parks below baseline
failure_condition: Weekly RETAIL_REC falls week-on-week in one-week-ahead readings while PARKS stays below -20.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean exceeds its last 28-day mean of -17.1 while RESIDENTIAL stays at or above +6 and WORKPLACES below -20.
